title: 05章废墟之上有花开06章诸天授道薪火传
lines: 天空昏昏沉沉，原本笼罩在天地之中的诡异云层也开始淡化消散，而就在此时，大地开始震动，若是有人从天空之中看去，大地就好像是一个原本蜷缩在一起的巨人，此时骤然在舒展身体，站了起来。
而依附于其上的渺小人类，则是遭到了毁天灭地的打击，一栋栋大楼瞬间灰飞烟灭，也有如同精准的切纸机一般，大片的建筑骤然的消失不见，但在世人的眼中，就好像在一瞬间化作了飞尘。
山岳开始怒吼，如同一个个远古巨人一般，努力地站直身躯，不断的拔高，刺破云海，欲与天公试比高，巨大的石块不断的滚落下来，无情地飞向人群，飞向了城镇、村落。
骤变仅仅持续了一瞬间，但是天地却是已经大变，虽然只是傍晚，但是大难之后的城镇，无不有着数道冲天而起的黑烟覆盖了阳光，太阳快落入了地平线，但是天色还没有暗下来，燃烧的城镇就像是一个个巨大的火把，将天地照耀得一片通红，给万物都笼罩上一层鲜红的颜色。
也像是给人类文明点燃最后的光明。
地动山摇，顷刻间，房屋塌陷，道路裂开；刹那间，一座座繁华的都市就变成一座座废墟。
城市中空荡荡的长街，空洞洞的门口，丢满了垃圾和废弃杂物的道路。街灯全部熄灭了，黑黝黝的街道上，肮脏的野狗在路边的垃圾堆里翻闹，见到惊慌失措的幸存者跑过，野狗抬起了头，朝着幸存者狂吠。
谁也想不到，如今这般如同鬼蜮魔界般的城市，会是曾经的繁华城市，可是这又是如今大陆之上真实的写照。
数之不尽的城市陷入了灭世的灾难之中，所有的城市都在大地的怒吼之中战栗，有政府机关之地、有体育场、有图书馆、有博物馆、历史展览馆，也有最先进的实验室，有着无数的文人古迹，庙宇众多，古迹林立，还有著无数宝贵的雕塑、建筑、园林，文明古刹、庙宇、古塔、圣地，古往今来名家大师的墨宝、诗作、绘图。
一切的一切，在这一瞬间，荟萃了历史和人文的精华，人类文明千年的积累，一代又一代天才的智慧结晶。
这一切，同化为了烟尘焦土，埋葬在尘埃废墟之中，全部灰飞烟灭。
混乱元年，天地骤变，母星遭受到了前所未有的打击，而乱局，却是在所有人猝不及防之中到来，当人们还沉浸在家园毁灭、亲族逝去的悲痛中时，更大的危机却是悄然浮现，没有人意识到，主宰这片土地数千年的人们，竟然会再一次遭受被狩猎的恐惧。
生存，成为了所有人的必修课。
这一切就像是一场噩梦，所有人都期盼着快点醒来，但是睁开眼却是入目的断壁残垣以及他人的哭天抢地，那一幕幕只会在电视中呈现的悲伤画面，就这么骤然出现在了所有人的眼前，就像是那个故事中的紫番薯，轻轻打了一个响指一般。
美丽的家乡，高耸的楼房，一切一切都瞬间化为乌有，变成触目惊心的废墟。
而与此同时，张荼所在神秘之地。
不远处的废墟随着洗礼的开始，发生了翻天覆地的变化。
“九州当歌征八荒，龙庭之内傲四海。旧袍青衣酒中仙，自在长空敢伐仙！”
“七十二路地煞将，再无来世！”
“问道数千载，却换来世缘。”
“古巷忧郁，一帘秋雨。”
“酸腐之极，且看我等一战功成！”
“时光飞逝天亦老，赤色神州生机现。”
一道道或雄浑或尖锐或沧桑或激昂的声音，从废墟之中传出，此时此刻，废墟之中出现数之不清的虚影，影影绰绰，似怨魂野鬼，又似一个历经千重劫白世难仍不肯闭目的不屈战魂。
边关月默然，一道道熟悉的身影出现在眼前，这数之不尽的英魂全部都是残念，是强者陨落后的残碎神念，是不灭怨气所化，灵识其实已破灭了。
他们，昔日都是自己的故友。
边关月默默地弯下了挺直的脊梁，泪水嘀嗒掉落在大地之上，落入了纷扬的骨粉，自从虚影出现之时，大地之上变得一片白茫茫，竟然有厚厚的一层白骨粉末，而远处的建筑也开始变得虚幻起来。
然而这一切，洗礼之中的张荼却是并不知道。
洗礼之中的张荼似是到了一个极致，原本臃肿肥硕的身躯以肉眼可见的速度开始消散，如同一个充满气的气球在不断地放水，而在下一秒，身躯直接四分五裂，鲜艳的血花在绽放，张荼在这一个忍受着炼狱般的痛苦，凄艳的红，染红了洗礼的光柱。
content_en:
The sky was gloomy, and the strange clouds that originally shrouded the sky and the earth began to fade and dissipate. At this moment, the earth began to shake. If someone looked from the sky, the earth seemed like a giant that was originally huddled together. At this time, it suddenly stretched its body and stood up.
The tiny human beings who were attached to it suffered a devastating blow. Buildings were instantly wiped out. Like a precise paper cutter, large areas of buildings suddenly disappeared, but in the eyes of the world, they seemed to turn into flying dust in an instant.
The mountains began to roar, like ancient giants, trying to stand up straight, rising higher and higher, piercing the sea of ​​clouds, trying to compete with the gods. Huge stones kept rolling down, flying ruthlessly towards the crowds, towns and villages.
The sudden change only lasted for a moment, but the world had already changed drastically. Although it was only evening, in the towns after the disaster, there were several black smoke rising into the sky, covering the sun. The sun was about to fall into the horizon, but the sky had not darkened yet. The burning towns were like huge torches, shining the sky and the earth brightly, covering everything with a bright red color.
It also seems to ignite the final light for human civilization.
The earth shook and the mountains shook. In an instant, houses collapsed and roads cracked. In an instant, prosperous cities turned into ruins.
The long empty streets in the city, the empty doorways, the roads filled with garbage and discarded debris. All the street lights were turned off. On the dark streets, dirty wild dogs were rummaging in the garbage on the roadside. When they saw the panicked survivors running past, the wild dogs raised their heads and barked at the survivors.
No one would have thought that the city that looks like a ghost world today would be the prosperous city it once was, but this is a true reflection of the current continent.
Countless cities have fallen into the catastrophe of destruction, and all cities are trembling in the roar of the earth. There are government agencies, stadiums, libraries, museums, historical exhibition halls, and state-of-the-art laboratories. There are countless literati monuments, numerous temples, and countless precious sculptures, buildings, gardens, civilized ancient temples, temples, ancient pagodas, holy places, and calligraphy, poems, and drawings of famous masters throughout the ages.
Everything, at this moment, gathers the essence of history and humanity, the accumulation of human civilization for thousands of years, and the crystallization of the wisdom of generations of geniuses.
All of this was assimilated into smoke and scorched earth, buried in dusty ruins, and completely destroyed.
In the first year of chaos, the world changed suddenly, and the mother planet suffered an unprecedented blow. However, the chaos came when everyone was caught off guard. When people were still immersed in the grief of the destruction of their homes and the death of their relatives, a greater crisis quietly emerged. No one realized that the people who had dominated this land for thousands of years would once again suffer the fear of being hunted.
Survival has become a required course for everyone.
All of this was like a nightmare. Everyone was looking forward to waking up soon, but when they opened their eyes, they saw the ruins of the walls and the crying of others. The sad scenes that would only be shown on TV suddenly appeared in front of everyone's eyes, just like the purple sweet potato in that story, just snapping their fingers.
The beautiful hometown, the towering buildings, everything was instantly reduced to nothing and turned into shocking ruins.
At the same time, Zhang Tu was in a mysterious place.
The ruins not far away underwent earth-shaking changes as the baptism began.
"Kiuzhou is singing to conquer the eight wastelands, and the Dragon Court is proud of the world. The immortal in the old robe and blue robe and wine, is free in the sky and dares to attack the immortal!"
"Seventy-two evil generals will never have another life!"
"Thousands of years of asking, but in exchange for worldly fate."
"The ancient alley is melancholy, and there is a curtain of autumn rain."
"It's extremely rotten. Let's wait and see if we can succeed in this battle!"
"Time flies and the sky grows old, and the red China is full of vitality."
Sounds that were either majestic or sharp, vicissitudes of life or passionate, came out from the ruins. At this moment, countless shadows appeared in the ruins, shadowy and shadowy, like ghosts and ghosts, and like an unyielding fighting spirit that refused to close its eyes after thousands of calamities and hardships in the world.
Bian Guanyue was silent, and one after another familiar figures appeared in front of him. These countless heroic souls were all residual thoughts. They were the fragmented spiritual thoughts after the death of the strong man. They were transformed by the immortal resentment, and the spiritual consciousness had actually been destroyed.
They were all his old friends in the past.
Bian Guanyue silently bent her straight spine, and her tears fell on the ground, falling into the scattered bone powder. Since the shadow appeared, the ground became completely white, with a thick layer of bone powder, and the buildings in the distance began to become illusory.
However, Zhang Tu, who was undergoing the baptism, did not know all this.
"Bang"
Zhang Tu seemed to have reached an extreme during the baptism. His originally bloated and fat body began to dissipate at a speed visible to the naked eye, like an inflated balloon that was constantly releasing water. And in the next second, his body was directly torn apart, and bright blood flowers bloomed. Zhang Tu endured the pain of purgatory here, and the miserable red stained the light beam of the baptism.
title_en: Chapter 05 There are flowers blooming on the ruins Chapter 06 The Heavens teach the way of fire
